So before we sign off on the draft submission to DOJ, I'd like to go around the table and give each of you the opportunity to confirm any facts you believe are material to the response. We need to be thorough here — the submission describes the matter as involving international distributor commissions, and we're proposing preserving relevant records and interviewing implicated personnel. Is there anything anyone needs to confirm or flag before we proceed?
